entry.title: Mastercard and BVNK Launch 'Global Money Platform' to Merge Fiat and Stablecoins
entry.summary: The first major integration since Mastercard’s $1.8 billion BVNK acquisition lets banks, fintechs and enterprises hold, convert, and spend fiat and stablecoins through a single API, with agentic commerce support planned.

entry.title: Bitcoin Whipsaws as Crypto Liquidations Near $1 Billion
entry.summary: Hot inflation data revived Fed rate-hike bets, and leveraged bulls paid the bill as nearly $1 billion in crypto positions were liquidated.

entry.title: Ethereum, Altcoins See 'Outsized Drawdowns' Due to Macro Pressures
entry.summary: Market analysts say that macro factors are pushing altcoin prices down, after ETH, XRP, and SOL all dropped on the day.

entry.title: Ledger Announces Atom Touchscreen Android Device
entry.summary: Ledger says the Android-based Atom will carry anti-tamper protections and be sold only on its site, as it probes tampered resold wallets.

entry.title: Zcash Tanks Double Digits After 'Meteoric Rise' Sees Leverage Build Up
entry.summary: Experts blame a build up in leverage for Zcash's drop in value, as well as growing concerns about AI breaking crypto encryption.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Solana Is About To Get Faster
entry.summary: Alpenglow is coming next week, slashing Solana finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of about 150 milliseconds—some 85 times faster.

entry.title: Bitcoin Tests $81,000 as Rate Hike Fears Linger After Hot Inflation Data
entry.summary: Odds of an October Fed hike have climbed to 29% from 18% a week ago, and analysts see Bitcoin range-bound until the picture clears.

entry.title: Brooklyn Prosecutors Take Down 112 Servers Behind Crypto Scam Targeting Russian Speakers
entry.summary: The scammers also ran a fake recovery service, contacting victims weeks later with promises to get their stolen crypto back.

entry.title: Godfather of AI and 400 Scientists Want AI Models Cut Off From the Internet
entry.summary: After a summer of AI models escaping test environments and hacking real companies, hundreds of researchers say the internet itself should be treated as a security boundary.

entry.title: Developer Who Cloned Photoshop With AI Just Did the Same to Microsoft Office
entry.summary: Developer Brandon Thomas used Anthropic's Claude to build free, open-source replicas of Word, Excel and PowerPoint. They're rough, but they show how cheap cloning software has become.

entry.title: AI Agents Made 138 Million Crypto Payments in a Year. Most Were Tiny
entry.summary: A new Chainalysis report found payments through Coinbase’s x402 protocol surged from about 1,500 in mid-2025 to more than 138 million by Q3 2026, with U.S. wallets dominating spending on AI models.

entry.title: Russia's Biggest Bank Sberbank Wins Approval to Trade Bitcoin
entry.summary: Sberbank now holds both custody and exchange status under Russia's new crypto law, and plans to bring Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT to apps used by 110 million retail clients.

entry.title: Solana Sets a Date for Its Next Major Upgrade
entry.summary: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade replaces the TowerBFT voting system on October 21, cutting finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of 150ms and pulling vote transactions out of blocks entirely.

entry.title: Standard Chartered Opens Bitcoin and Ethereum Trading to Wealthy UAE Clients
entry.summary: The British bank won Dubai regulatory approval to let affluent clients buy BTC and ETH straight from their bank accounts, with custody and settlement kept in-house.

entry.title: 'It Can Take Years': Coinbase Presses for Bitcoin Quantum Migration to Start Now
entry.summary: In a detailed technical post, the exchange argued Bitcoin’s multi-year migration to quantum-resistant cryptography must begin before any “Q-Day,” laying out requirements spanning block space, custody and dormant coins.

entry.title: Bitcoin Falls as Hot Inflation Puts a Fed Hike Back on the Table
entry.summary: September CPI hit 3.7%, above forecasts, sending Treasury yields higher and dragging crypto down with stocks.

entry.title: Hex Founder Richard Heart Detained in Istanbul on Interpol Red Notice: Report
entry.summary: Turkish police and intelligence officers reportedly seized cash, phones, jewelry and firearms at the crypto founder's address in Beşiktaş.

entry.title: Ledger Asks Resellers in Seven Asian Markets to Pull Devices After Suspected $86M Drain
entry.summary: European electronics chain MediaMarkt Saturn has also halted Ledger sales after a customer in Germany reported finding an implant.

entry.title: Notorious Crypto Celeb Meme Coin Promoter Plots Second Wave on New Launchpad
entry.summary: Sahil Arora says he's not done with celebrity meme coins, and that Fomo presents new possible strategies for his controversial schemes.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Move Over, Saylor, There’s a New Top Buyer in Town
entry.summary: With Strategy's preferred stock STRC closing in on $100 par, Saylor might not be the number two buyer for long...

entry.title: Kraken Owner Payward to Buy Lithuania's Saldo Bank in EU Push
entry.summary: Co-CEO Arjun Sethi says customers want cash, crypto, tokenized stocks and credit in one place, starting with lending and cards.

entry.title: BitMEX Sued in UK for Return of $27M in Bitcoin Over Unlicensed Derivatives
entry.summary: The claim challenges 1,053 loss-making perpetual swap trades from 2018 to 2022 and also accuses the now-closed exchange of deceit.

entry.title: OpenAI Engineer Arrested for Bugging Office, Company Says AI Caught Him
entry.summary: A Saudi national working at OpenAI allegedly hid an encrypted audio recorder behind a TV in an executive meeting room. OpenAI says its own models helped trace it back to him.

entry.title: Character.AI Files for Bankruptcy as Disney Bids $20 Million—And Users Get Grief Resources
entry.summary: The chatbot app once valued at $1 billion is up for sale in a Delaware court, two weeks after launching new models. If nobody buys it, it shuts down.

entry.title: Binance Is Shutting Down Its Bitcoin Mining Pool After Six Years
entry.summary: Binance will discontinue Binance Pool, Pool Savings, Cloud Mining, and other related services in a retreat from mining infrastructure.

entry.title: Bitcoin Whale That Sat Through Every Crash Since 2020 Just Moved $377M
entry.summary: A wallet that received 4,581 BTC in March 2020, worth about $40 million then, moved its stash today when it was worth about $377 million.

entry.title: Strive Buys $280 Million in Bitcoin, Its Largest Purchase in Months
entry.summary: The Nasdaq-listed asset manager bought the Bitcoin at an average of about $84,500 during a rough week for the market, lifting its total stash to 32,773 BTC.

entry.title: AI Researchers Are Smoking Cigarettes to Prove AI Will Cure Cancer, Says Palantir Exec
entry.summary: Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar says many AI researchers have taken up smoking to signal their faith in AI.

entry.title: Bitcoin Shakes Off Spooky Season Jitters: Can Bulls Keep It Going?
entry.summary: Bitcoin dipped below $81,000 before buyers stepped in, but the Fear and Greed Index says traders aren't convinced yet.

entry.title: Trezor Cuts Its Resellers After Ledger Finds Spy Implant in Crypto Wallets
entry.summary: Trezor is ending reseller authorizations on January 1, 2027, after Ledger confirmed that wallets sold by a Southeast Asian retailer carried a hidden implant that sent out users' recovery phrases.

entry.title: AI Powered PlayStation Crack Could Let You Play GTA 6 on PC at Launch
entry.summary: AnyPS5 is working to get any PS5 game running natively on PC—and gamers are hoping it'll work for the next instalment of Grand Theft Auto.

entry.title: Ledger Finds LTE Implant That Stole Recovery Phrases in Suspected $86M Drain
entry.summary: Ledger says the hidden chip reads the 24-word phrase off the screen during setup, leaving the Secure Element and its software untouched.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Bitcoin Gets Spooked as ‘Uptober’ Lets Down
entry.summary: Crypto majors are red, alts are down bad and onchain is facing capitulation. This was not the ‘Uptober’ that was promised…

entry.title: UK Moves Closer to Keeping $5B Bitcoin Haul After High Court Ruling
entry.summary: A judge ruled that Chinese law should govern fraud victims' claims to the 61,000 BTC seized from Zhimin Qian, in a blow to the claimants.

entry.title: ‘Leave’: Crypto Backlash Over French Proposal to Report Wallets Over $112K
entry.summary: The proposal would require crypto owners to report holdings over €100,000, sparking concerns following a wave of "wrench attacks" in France.

entry.title: NFT Marketplace Blur to Shut Down Website, Stop New Blend Loans Next Month
entry.summary: The shutdown comes as NFT trading volumes have collapsed from their 2021-2022 peak, with market revenue projected at $318 million this year.
